title: Flavor units (units.json)
description: Display formatting only. Distances and speeds stay canonical (klik, kps) on the wire; a flavor converts when showing a value to a human.

base.description: Label for the canonical unit (core: klik).

ladder.description: Auto-scaling rungs, ordered by descending min. The formatter picks the largest rung whose min the value reaches.

min.description: Smallest canonical value this rung covers.

factor.description: Canonical units per display unit (the formatter divides by it).

base.description: Label for the canonical speed unit (core: kps).

dial.description: Labels for the shared 0-100 speed dial. Keys are numbers in 0..100.
